evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: Foundation models for human brain recordings are usually evaluated by signal reconstruction, future-state prediction, and transfer to downstream tasks.

evidence.label: 描述评分指标或评测协议
evidence.excerpt: We define perturbational validity as the preservation, after limited system-specific adaptation, of the conditional distribution of future trajectories given the current state and a controlled input, and we evaluate it at three levels: time-series accuracy, dynamical-structure similarity, and responses to perturbations excluded from calibration.
